moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio catalog-ui-button-wobble-tilt, written here): From rest at the tap (0.5 s): angle = 0.24 × e^(−2.4 t) × sin(9 t) rad (first swing about 9°), pivot at the bottom centre; faded to 0 between 1.5-1.9 s after the tap. Equivalent spring k144 d5.6 (site value). Button 130x44 r14. Params: at · amp (0.24 rad) · freq (9 rad/s) · decay (2.4) · pivot (đáy giữa). angle = amp × e^(−decay t) × sin(freq t) about the bottom centre; about a spring k 144, damping 5.6.
